narratives.Description: feat(scm,swarm): require search of existing closed issues and PRs before filing — pre-filing duplicate check
narratives.Overview:
This Recut is self-contained. Predecessor Bound-remedy limbs do not carry unless restated below.

1. **Shared bounded retrieval with explicit coverage and PR-file completeness.** One thin retrieval contract (or twin helpers) for closed issues and closed PRs. Closed-issue walk: `sort=updated&direction=desc`, exclude `pull_request` rows from match set and retained-issue count, named default `PREFILING_CLOSED_ISSUE_WINDOW`. Closed-PR walk: named default `PREFILING_CLOSED_PR_WINDOW`, bind PR ordering/pagination including file-list pagination so path-intersection cannot silently use truncated files. Outcome tokens: `window-exhausted` | `list-exhausted` | `cap` | `error`. Distinguish successful configured-window coverage and successful list exhaustion (bounded no-match within declared coverage) from failure/cap/truncated PR-file enumeration. Never treat incomplete retrieval as verified no-match or as exhaustive historical clearance. Do not import #5099 feedback:file constants unless separately exported for this purpose.

2. **Evidence-based disposition: implemented, partial, declined, unresolved.** Prefer `state_reason` (`completed` vs `not_planned`) plus body/decision evidence and merged closing-PR signals. Full implementation → drop covered proposal portions and cite; partial → cite and keep uncovered delta; explicit decline → surface prior decision before re-file offer; unresolved → disclose, do not claim verified no-match. Same-path PR overlap discovers candidates; it does not prove duplicate scope alone.

3. **Article-review requires both closed-issue and closed-PR passes before presentation and filing (pack-source → packs:render).** Before Step 6 present / Step 7 file-offer, Step 5 MUST run closed-issue retrieval+disposition AND closed-PR shortlist+body/scope disposition from limbs 1–2 — even when no linked issue exists. Proposal-time PR candidates use the bounded PR list and semantic body review; do not require a concrete changed-file set at propose time, and do not introduce Search API ranking. Inherit existing Step 5 body-level ownership for closed hits. Keep open-issue shortlist. Anti-pattern: propose/file after only an open-state issue scan, or after closed-issue-only with closed-PR search left merely callable.

4. **First-PR-open closed-PR pass; swarm points to its owner.** Own path-intersection closed-PR pass on `deft-directive-pre-pr` (and any implement-leaf `gh pr create` bypass must call the same contract). Mechanical trigger: any closed/merged PR inside `PREFILING_CLOSED_PR_WINDOW` whose files intersect the candidate changed-path set → MUST cite that PR and state what differs. Swarm Phase 6 stays merge/protected-issue/finalize and MUST point at the pre-pr owner. Anti-pattern: open a product PR with no closed-PR path-intersection pass.

5. **Thin AGENTS / agents-entry pointer.** Short MUST in agents-entry (then `task agents:refresh`) that filing new issues or opening PRs requires the closed-issue/PR pre-filing contract owned by article-review / pre-pr. Pointer only — no window or disposition table paste into AGENTS.md.

6. **Behavioral fixtures prove caller timing and PR-only proposal suppression.** Lock MUST / anti-pattern tokens in article-review and pre-pr content tests. Fixtures MUST include: (a) merged in-window PR implements entire Step-4 suggestion with no linked closed issue → Step 5 suppresses/disposes before Step 6/7 (not helper-only); (b) partial completion; (c) closed-unmerged ambiguity; (d) mixed pagination / PR-row exclusion; (e) incomplete retrieval must not become verified no-match. Token presence alone is not proof the search ran at the right gate.

7. **Keep-outs.** #5099 Prefer-A Bound conflict_group `feedback-file-open-comment-closed-account` — cite-only. #1102 shipped master-diff — do not rewrite. Exhaustive closed-history search rejected. Search API / body-similarity ranking rejected. Auto-reopen declined rejected. AGENTS disposition-table paste rejected. Phase-6-as-first-open-owner rejected.

Reject: B (CLI-only without skill MUST); C (AGENTS-only prose); D (absorb into #5099).
